page.overview:
Who is Kinro Billix?

Kinro Billix was a human male castellan of the ore-baroness Jae Mordant. Billix saw her as if she was his own daughter, and, in turn, she regarded him as an uncle. By 19 BBY, he had become infected with the Shadow Plague, which turned him against Mordant, and joined the Infinite Coil. After his infection, he and the Coil laid a trap for Mordant and Zero Company. As hoped, Mordant and the group travelled to the planet Florrum in an attempt to rescue him from the Coil, only to discover his infection and be attacked. He was killed in the firefight that followed.

Kinro Billix appeared in the video game Star Wars Zero Company, which released on August 27, 2026.
